params.name: leagueId
params.description: Returns team information for all teams under the specified leagueId.

params.name: teamId
params.description: Returns team information for the specified teamId.

params.name: day
params.description: Returns team data that has been added or modified within the specified number of days, e.g. day=1 or day=2.

items.docs:
• This API endpoint returns basketball team profile information. Filter by leagueId or teamId; if both are omitted, returns information for all teams. 



• Note that detailed fields such as website, conference, division, city, venue, capacity, joinYear, and coach may return empty or 0 for teams in lower-tier leagues where such information is not tracked.

params.name: cmd
params.description: Fixed value new. Required for this endpoint to return data correctly.

params.name: day
params.description: Returns player data that has been added or modified within the specified number of days, e.g. day=1 or day=2.

items.docs:
• This API endpoint returns basketball player profile information. All players are returned by default.



• Note: The request must include the parameter cmd=new, e.g. http://api.isportsapi.com/sport/basketball/player?api_key=<YOUR_API_KEY>&cmd=new.

• This API endpoint returns stage type information for basketball cups, such as qualifying rounds, group stages, and regular season. 



• The recordId returned by this endpoint corresponds to the stageId field in the Schedule & Results endpoint, allowing you to match a specific match to its cup stage.

• This API endpoint returns playoff stage type information for basketball leagues, such as Quarter Final, Semi Final, and Final. 



• The recordId returned by this endpoint corresponds to the playoffsId field in the Schedule & Results endpoint, allowing you to match a specific match to its playoff stage.

params.name: leagueId
params.description: Returns profile information for the specified leagueId. If omitted, returns profile information for all leagues and cups.

items.docs: This API endpoint returns complete profile information for basketball leagues and cups, including league rules, ranking format, and season details. Click here to view all leagues & cups.

params.name: name
params.description: Team name to search for. Supports fuzzy search.

items.docs:
• This API endpoint supports searching for basketball team information by team name, with fuzzy matching supported. 



• Note that detailed fields such as website, conference, division, city, venue, capacity, joinYear, and coach may return empty or 0 for teams in lower-tier leagues where such information is not tracked.

params.name: cmd
params.description: Fixed value new. Required for this endpoint to return data correctly.

params.name: name
params.description: Player name to search for. Supports fuzzy search.

items.docs:
• This API endpoint supports searching for basketball player information by player name, with fuzzy matching supported.



• Note: The request must include the parameter cmd=new, e.g. http://api.isportsapi.com/sport/basketball/player/search?api_key=<YOUR_API_KEY>&cmd=new&name=James.
